deliverable: SENTINEL cross-cutting transfer-gap framework: in-distribution vs out-of-distribution generalization gap for every model, and how much the transferable-representation fixes reduce it.
thesis: Across five real SENTINEL benchmarks the same pattern holds: models look strong under in-distribution (random / within-study / with-geography / within-region) evaluation and drop sharply out-of-distribution (geographic-holdout / leave-one-study-out / no-geography / cross-region). Transferable representations that discard sensor/region/study-specific idiosyncrasy — coarse taxonomy, per-sample rank normalization, the physically-correct red-edge band, and non-redundant modality fusion — recover a substantial, statistically-supported fraction of that gap, but never close it entirely. The honest deployment number is the OOD number.
gap_definition: transfer_gap = ID_score - OOD_score (same metric). gap_reduction_frac_of_gap = (OOD_fixed - OOD_raw) / (ID - OOD_raw): the fraction of the ID->OOD collapse that the transferable representation recovers.

table.ood_setting: TRUE geographic holdout (k-means regions on real lat/lon; 0 region leakage)
table.fix: multi-rank taxonomic CLR features (phylum..genus) replacing raw ASVs
table.verdict: FIX REDUCES GAP: +0.272 macro-F1 OOD; recovers ~64% of the raw->random gap. Same-split raw-OTU control (0.571) confirms the gain is the FEATURE representation, not the classifier.

table.ood_setting: leave-one-study-out (LOSO) across 12 real NCBI GEO studies
table.fix: per-sample rank/quantile normalization (equalize each array's marginal distribution)
table.verdict: FIX REDUCES GAP: LOSO AUROC 0.557->0.642 (95% CI [0.564,0.735] clears chance and the 0.55 floor); 8/12 held-out studies improve. Recovers ~28% of the within->cross-study gap. Large residual gap remains: cross-study exposure signature is largely study-specific.

table.task: species occupancy (present/absent), USGS BioData; macro over 3 informative taxa
table.id_setting: with geographic range prior (lat/lon available at inference) [+leaked count features previously gave AUROC=1.0, RETRACTED]
table.ood_setting: environment-only, geography REMOVED (no lat/lon/region) — the deploy-anywhere setting where the range prior is unavailable
table.fix: NON-target community richness/count (biotic context) — the count-independent, transferable environmental signal
table.verdict: GAP IS THE HONEST STORY: dropping the geographic range prior costs 0.091 macro-AUROC (0.944->0.853). Rare range-restricted taxa lose the most (their skill IS the range prior); the widespread mussel is the honest environmental case (0.855->0.777). The previously headlined AUROC=1.000 was CIRCULAR label leakage and is retracted.

table.task: chlorophyll-a regression from Sentinel-2 tiles (optically-active WQ)
table.id_setting: station holdout mean-R2 across 5 WQ params (already OOD by station) [temp R2=0.729]
table.ood_setting: STATION GroupKFold holdout, chl-a only (no site shared train/test)
table.fix: add Sentinel-2 RED-EDGE band B05 (705nm) + NDCI/CIre/MCIre indices
table.verdict: FIX IMPROVES OOD SKILL: red-edge lifts station-holdout chl-a R2 0.178->0.320 (delta +0.143, 95% CI [0.100,0.188], P(improve)=1.0). Red-edge is the physically correct band for chlorophyll; the shipped 4-band (RGB+NIR) rep was blind to it. mc>1.6 AUROC also +0.026 (CI excl 0); mc>0.3 null.

table.task: cyanotoxin (microcystin) exceedance classification — optically INVISIBLE target
table.id_setting: station-grouped CV within the sampled regions (mc>1.6 WHO-drinking)
table.fix: + domain descriptors (lat/lon/month) — partial; genotype (mcyD) modality DATA-BLOCKED
table.verdict: FUSION WINS WITHIN-REGION (3-way 0.823 > 2-way 0.776 > best single 0.684; driver gain CI excl 0), but cross-REGION it collapses to ~chance (0.485->0.527 with domain descriptors). The transfer key (toxic-strain genotype / mcyD) is not co-located with mc measurements on disk — honest DATA-BLOCKED null.

table.task: label-free early detection of DO-hypoxia onset (NEON), specificity on clean periods
table.metric: pooled-control held-out sustained FPR (lower=better) @ matched operating point
table.id_setting: per-site global-threshold baseline (validated on stationary sites)
table.ood_setting: non-stationary held-out clean control periods (covariate/temporal drift)
table.fix: strictly-causal rolling-baseline multivariate CUSUM change-point detector
table.verdict: FIX REDUCES DRIFT-INDUCED FALSE POSITIVES at matched FPR: pooled-control held-out FPR 9.7%->6.9%, validated episodes 8/12->10/12, partial detection-AUC@5%FPR 0.163->0.744. Rolling CUSUM adapts the operating point to non-stationarity — a temporal covariate-shift fix. (Trade-off: still 6.9% vs a stationary-only baseline of 4.6%.)

HydroViT_chla_R2.note: station-holdout is already OOD; no ID number, so reported as absolute OOD lift.

mean_fraction_note: Mean over the 3 benchmarks with a like-for-like ID/OOD gap AND a feature fix (MicroBiomeNet, ToxiGene, Microcystin-cross-region). HydroViT reported as absolute OOD lift; Species/TrackA reported separately (gap is the finding / FPR not accuracy).

reporting_framework.principle_1_headline_the_OOD_number: Report the worst realistic-shift number as the headline, not the random-split number. Random/per-sample splits overstate ecological AUC by up to ~0.16 and MAE by 70-80% under spatial autocorrelation (Roberts et al.; spatial-blocking literature). Every SENTINEL model here shows the same inflation (e.g. MicroBiomeNet 0.831 random -> 0.405 geographic).
reporting_framework.principle_2_name_the_shift_axis: State WHICH axis is held out (geography / study / region / station / time) and enforce zero leakage on it (region k-means, LOSO, station GroupKFold, temporal). ID and OOD both reported; never OOD-only-when-flattering.
reporting_framework.principle_3_transferable_representations: Prefer representations that are invariant to the nuisance axis: coarse taxonomy over exact ASVs (shared across continents), per-sample rank-norm over global z-score (removes per-array batch geometry), physical spectral indices over raw bands, and modality fusion only where modalities are genuinely non-redundant (microcystin, not chl-a/DO).
reporting_framework.principle_4_per_domain_calibration_plus_: At deployment, calibrate per region/study/station (a small labeled calibration set per new domain) and emit distribution-free uncertainty via conformal prediction. Standard split-conformal assumes exchangeability; under covariate shift use WEIGHTED conformal (Tibshirani et al. 2019) with importance weights estimated from unlabeled target features, so prediction sets stay valid when the test covariate distribution moves.
reporting_framework.principle_5_report_worst_group_not_just_: Report worst-region / worst-study performance alongside the pooled mean; aggregation hides OOD failure (per-class freshwater_sediment F1=0.0 and per-study sub-chance AUROC are invisible in the macro average).

honest_verdict: The transfer gap is real and universal across SENTINEL. The transferable-representation fixes are genuine, measured, leakage-free wins that recover a meaningful fraction of the gap (mean ~44% of the ID->OOD collapse across the three comparable feature-fix benchmarks) — but none fully closes it, and two settings (Species range prior, Microcystin cross-region) are honest gaps/nulls where the fix is unavailable or data-blocked. SENTINEL's scientific contribution is not any single model beating a baseline; it is the demonstration, on real environmental data, that (a) in-distribution scores systematically overstate deployable skill, and (b) representations chosen to be invariant to the deployment shift axis measurably shrink that overstatement.
